phrases.text: Tap their shoulders and shout. Are they responding?
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, adult BLS recognition

phrases.text: Are they breathing normally? Gasping does not count.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, adult BLS recognition

phrases.text: Gasping is not normal breathing. Treat it as not breathing.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, abnormal breathing

phrases.text: Call 911 now if nobody has. Tap Mark breath each time they breathe.
phrases.citation: Project proposal, needs clinician approval. See docs/research_brief.md, critique finding 1

phrases.text: Are they still breathing normally?
phrases.citation: Project proposal, needs clinician approval. See docs/research_brief.md, critique finding 1

phrases.text: If you are sure, tap yes. If not, we start CPR.
phrases.citation: Project safety rule. Lowering urgency requires a human

phrases.text: Call 911 now, on speaker. If someone is with you, have them call.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, activate EMS

phrases.text: Calling 911 for you.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, activate EMS. Project design: the 911 agent places the call in the background, simulated in this build, so the rescuer is not stopped to dial

phrases.text: Roll them flat on their back, on a firm surface.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, firm surface

phrases.text: Heel of one hand on the center of the chest. Other hand on top.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, hand position

phrases.text: Adopt this grip. Dominant hand over the other, fingers laced, and hold tight.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, hand position: one hand on top of the other, fingers interlaced

phrases.text: Push hard and fast, in time with the beat. Do not stop.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, compression rate

phrases.text: Push hard, at least two inches. Let the chest come back up.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, compression depth and recoil

phrases.text: If someone can take over, switch now. Keep pauses short.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, switching compressors

phrases.text: Do not check for a pulse. Keep pushing.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, lay rescuers do not rely on pulse checks

phrases.text: Keep going. Do not stop until help takes over.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, continue CPR

phrases.text: Someone else here? Have them call 911 and find an AED.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, multiple rescuers

phrases.text: AED spotted. Have someone bring it here. Keep pushing.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, AED use

phrases.text: Turn the AED on and follow its voice. Keep pushing until it says stop.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, AED use

phrases.text: Bare the chest. Stick the pads where the pictures show.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, AED pad placement

phrases.text: Pads are on. Follow the AED now. Stay clear when it says.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, AED use

phrases.text: If the AED says to push, or nothing is happening, start pushing.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, resume CPR after AED

phrases.text: Start pushing again now, hard and fast.
phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, resume CPR after AED

phrases.text: Stay with them. Call 911 if they seem unwell, and watch their breathing.
phrases.citation: Project static card, needs clinician approval

phrases.text: Are they still responding and breathing normally? If not, tap Not responding now.
phrases.citation: Project proposal, needs clinician approval. No direct guideline source for the wording or interval

phrases.text: Call 911 and follow the dispatcher's instructions.
phrases.citation: Project static card. Child, infant, drowning, and pregnancy defer to the dispatcher

phrases.text: Call 911 and follow the dispatcher. Tap Back if you tapped this by mistake.
phrases.citation: Project proposal, needs clinician approval. No direct guideline source for the wording or interval

phrases.text: Show this card to the paramedics.
phrases.citation: Project handoff card

phrases.citation: AHA 2025 Part 7, continue CPR
